title: Grizzly vs. Panda vs. Polar Bear
grammar: Too, too much, too many, enough

questions.sentence: Polar bear males can weigh as much as ten men. They are _____ heavy for a human to lift.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: They are too heavy for a human to lift.
They are enough heavy for a human to lift.
They are too much heavy for a human to lift.
They are many heavy for a human to lift.

questions.sentence: Pandas eat up to 50 pounds of bamboo a day. That's _____ bamboo for a person.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: That's too much bamboo for a person.
That's too many bamboo for a person.
That's too much bamboos for a person.
That's enough bamboo for a person.

questions.sentence: A sun bear's tongue can be up to 10 inches long — that's _____ long to reach into a beehive.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Its tongue is long enough to reach into a beehive.
Its tongue is too long to reach into a beehive.
Its tongue is enough long to reach into a beehive.
Its tongue is long too to reach into a beehive.

questions.sentence: Pandas spend 16 hours a day eating. They don't have _____ time to sleep.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: They don't have enough time to sleep.
They don't have too time to sleep.
They don't have enough time sleeping.
They have enough not time to sleep.

questions.sentence: The polar bear is the largest land carnivore. It is _____ big to be a pet.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: It is too big to be a pet.
It is enough big to be a pet.
It is too much big to be a pet.
It is big enough to be a pet.

questions.sentence: The sun bear is the smallest bear. It is small _____ to climb trees easily.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: It is small enough to climb trees easily.
It is too small to climb trees easily.
It is enough small to climb trees easily.
It is small too to climb trees easily.

questions.sentence: Most bears are faster than they look. They are _____ fast to catch easily.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: They are too fast to catch easily.
They are fast enough to catch easily.
They are too much fast to catch easily.
They are enough fast to catch easily.

questions.correct: Pandas eat too much bamboo for a person.
